title: 第5章 血脉枷锁第6章 紫瞳重明鸟
slug: 万古第一神第7596章第三轮
content_zh:
幸好李天命在离火城还有一些家业。
被逐出城主府之后，母子两人还能有一处落脚之地。
新的住处是一间破旧的庭院。
他知道，他不会在这里住太久，得到能够进炎黄学宫的‘炎黄令’，他就会离开离火城。
夜里直到母亲安心入眠，李天命才离开母亲的寝室。
“小老弟，今天表现不错啊。”
夜风之下，李天命将头顶上的小黄鸡拎了下来。
这货把自己头发当鸟巢了。
“少废话，快点把今天得到的‘灵矿’拿出来，老子饿了。”
小黄鸡已经急不可耐了。
它口中的灵矿，就是李炎枫休妻废子之后‘大发慈悲’赐予的‘宝玉’，足够两个凡人过一辈子的钱财。
所谓灵矿，乃是天地之间的矿石，经受长久的天地灵气和地脉灵蕴孕养而诞生。
灵矿拥有各种神奇的灵蕴，可以用来锻造兵器，也有许多其他功效。
‘宝玉’也算是一种灵矿，其蕴含巨量的天地灵气，对御兽师和伴生兽都有裨益。
故而，宝玉也用来做御兽师的‘货币’，每一枚宝玉的价值，都超过金银珠宝。
可以充当流通货币的‘宝玉’有好几种，其中蕴含‘火焰灵气’的‘火玉’在朱雀国最为流通。
此外还有金玉、雷玉等，都是日常流通的货币，可以用来购买许多修炼资源。
李天命将早上得到的宝玉全部拿出来，摊开桌上一数，大概有两百的火玉和五十左右的金玉。
“还挺大方，够两个普通人过两辈子了。”
李天命冷笑了一声。

一世情缘，就换来了这些东西。
“这是什么？”
小黄鸡指着这些宝玉上都存在的一种纹路问。
“这叫天纹。”
桌上那些火玉和金玉上，都有着一条细微的赤色纹路。
这种纹路是水都清洗不掉的，这就是‘天纹’。
拥有天纹，才能称得上为‘灵矿’。
据说天纹乃是天地意志的体现，蕴含着天地本源力量的秘密。
很多高层次的御兽师，都在参悟天纹来突破自身的极限，掌控天地的力量。
所以，天纹全称为‘天意纹路’。
“天纹有九种颜色，分别为赤橙黄绿青蓝紫黑白，赤色天纹是层次最低的，白色天纹层次最高。”
“拥有白色天纹的灵矿那绝对是旷世奇宝，据说白色天纹极其复杂，简直像是纹路的阵图。”
李天命目前为止，也就见识过赤色天纹、橙色天纹和黄色天纹。
眼前这些宝玉都只是赤色天纹灵矿，虽然是最普通的，但对李天命目前的境界修炼来说，也有一定的裨益。
宝玉本身蕴含的天地灵气释放出来，可以加速兽元的转化和凝聚。
“什么天纹，乱七八糟的，在爷面前都是美食。”
小黄鸡嘟囔着，竟然跳到追上去，张开嘴要吃这些宝玉。
“兄弟，别逗了，这东西是用来炼化的，不是用来吃的。”
正常来说，御兽师和伴生兽的修炼确实需要宝玉加速。
不过，首先要释放出宝玉中的天地灵气，然后再一起吸收炼化。

“你知道个毛。”
李天命吃惊的事情发生了。
content_en:
Fortunately, Li Tianming still has some family business in Lihuo City.
After being expelled from the City Lord's Mansion, the mother and son still had a place to stay.
The new residence is a dilapidated courtyard.
He knew that he would not live here for long, and he would leave Lihuo City after getting the 'Yanhuang Order' that would allow him to enter the Yanhuang Academy.
At night, Li Tianming didn't leave his mother's bedroom until his mother fell asleep peacefully.
"Little brother, you performed well today."
Under the night wind, Li Tianming lifted the little yellow chicken off his head.
This guy is using his hair as a bird's nest.
"Stop talking nonsense and quickly take out the 'spiritual mine' you got today. I'm hungry."
The little yellow chicken was impatient.
The spiritual mine it spoke of was the 'jewel' given by Li Yanfeng 'out of mercy' after he divorced his wife and abandoned his son. It was enough money for two mortals to live a lifetime.
The so-called spiritual mine is an ore between heaven and earth, which is born after a long period of nourishment by the spiritual energy of heaven and earth and the spiritual energy of the earth.
Spirit mines contain various magical spiritual essences that can be used to forge weapons and have many other effects.
‘Baoyu’ can also be regarded as a kind of spiritual mine, which contains a huge amount of spiritual energy from heaven and earth, which is beneficial to beast masters and companion beasts.
Therefore, gems and jade are also used as the 'currency' of beast masters. Each gem is worth more than gold, silver and jewelry.
There are several kinds of 'jewels' that can be used as currency, among which the 'fire jade' containing 'fire aura' is the most circulated in the Suzaku Kingdom.
In addition, there are gold, jade, thunder jade, etc., which are currencies in daily circulation and can be used to purchase many cultivation resources.
Li Tianming took out all the jade he got in the morning, spread it out on the table and counted, there were about two hundred fire jade and about fifty gold jade.
"It's quite generous, enough for two ordinary people to live two lifetimes."
Li Tianming sneered.
A lifetime of love has resulted in these things.
"What is this?"
The little yellow chicken pointed at a pattern that existed on these jade stones and asked.
"This is called a sky pattern."
There is a subtle red line on the fire jade and gold jade on the table.
This kind of pattern cannot be washed away by water. This is the ‘sky pattern’.
Only by possessing the sky pattern can it be called a ‘spiritual mine’.
It is said that the sky patterns are the embodiment of the will of heaven and earth, and contain the secret of the original power of heaven and earth.
Many high-level beast masters are studying the heavenly patterns to break through their own limits and control the power of heaven and earth.
Therefore, the full name of the sky pattern is "the pattern of heaven's will".
"There are nine colors of sky patterns, namely red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, black and white. Red sky patterns are the lowest level, and white sky patterns are the highest level."
"The spiritual mine with the white sky pattern is definitely a rare treasure. It is said that the white sky pattern is extremely complex, almost like a pattern of patterns."
Li Tianming has only seen red sky patterns, orange sky patterns and yellow sky patterns so far.
The gems in front of him are all red sky-marked spiritual mines. Although they are the most common ones, they are also of certain benefit to Li Tianming's current state of cultivation.
The release of the spiritual energy of heaven and earth contained in the jade itself can accelerate the transformation and condensation of beast essence.
"What kind of sky pattern? It's a mess. It's all delicious food in front of me."
The little yellow chicken muttered, jumped up to catch up, and opened its mouth to eat these precious jade.
"Brother, don't be ridiculous. This thing is for refining, not for eating."
Normally, the cultivation of beast masters and companion beasts does require gems to accelerate.
However, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth in the jade must first be released, and then absorbed and refined together.
"You know shit."
Something surprising happened to Li Tianming.
